newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Jan-May surplus at 4.92 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Jan-May surplus at 4.92 bln pesos.

text.p: The Philippines' budget surplus fell to 4.92 billion pesos in the first five months of the year, down from 12.56 billion a year earlier, according to preliminary figures released by the Bureau of Treasury on Monday.
The end-May level was sharply lower than the 18.2 billion pesos registered as of end of April.
Five-month revenues reached 179.78 billion pesos, while expenses amounted to 174.87 billion.
The biggest revenue collector was the Bureau of Internal Revenue which contributed 129.67 billion pesos during the period.
